**Acceptance Criteria**

REQ-01 is mostly covered: `.claude/skills/jit-planning-lead/SKILL.md:202` instructs auditing inherited upstream dependencies before plan completion and classifying each edge as planning-required or implementation-consumed.

REQ-02 is not met in an executable way. The new text says the implementation-consumed edge should remain on P until “breakdown time (Step 5)” (`.claude/skills/jit-planning-lead/SKILL.md:207`), but Step 5 only runs after “the plan is approved and P is done” (`.claude/skills/jit-planning-lead/SKILL.md:230`). If the inherited dependency is still on P, P cannot be marked done, so the workflow never reaches Step 5. The documented fix preserves the deadlock.

REQ-03 is covered at `.claude/skills/jit-planning-lead/SKILL.md:209`: planning-required dependencies that cannot complete are escalated rather than dropped or forced through.
